name: DownloadFilesFromFtp
label: Download File(s) from FTP
description: Downloads one or more files from an FTP server.

fields.name: DownloadMultipleFiles
fields.label: Download Multiple Files
fields.description: Whether to download a single file or multiple files.

fields.name: FileName
fields.label: File Name
fields.description: The name of the file to download.

fields.name: FileNames
fields.label: File Name List
fields.description: The names of the file to download.

fields.name: LocalDirectory
fields.label: Local Directory
fields.description: The local directory to save the downloaded files.

fields.name: TransferType
fields.label: Transfer Type
fields.description: The transfer type to use (ASCII or Binary).

fields.name: IfFileExists
fields.label: If File Exists
fields.description: The operation to perform if the file already exists locally.

selectOptions.label: Overwrite
selectOptions.description: Overwrite the file if it exists.

selectOptions.label: Don't Download
selectOptions.description: Don't download the file if it exists.

selectOptions.label: Download with Unique Name
selectOptions.description: Download the file with a unique name if it exists.

fields.name: DownloadedFilesCount
fields.label: Downloaded Files Count
fields.description: Returns the number of files successfully downloaded.

fields.name: SkippedFiles
fields.label: Skipped Files
fields.description: Returns the list of files that were skipped during download.
